Data Controller:

Fundación Bancaria Caixa d'Estalvis i Pensions de Barcelona, ”la Caixa” (hereinafter, ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation), with NIF G-58899998 and registered office at Avenida Diagonal, numbers 621–629, Tower II, 08028 Barcelona (Spain).

Types of personal data to be processed (hereinafter, personal data):

All the data you provide us when making your purchase request.

Any additional data you provide us during the processing and management of your purchase request, as well as those related to the other data processing described in this document, provided you have given us your consent or we are otherwise legitimized to process them in accordance with current regulations.

Personal data you provide us through a social network or other application for the management of the data processing described in this document, provided you have given us your consent or we are otherwise legitimized to process them in accordance with current regulations. Specifically, your personal data available on the social network or application and those derived from the interaction with you through them will be processed. These data depend on your own privacy settings, the use of the social network or application, and the privacy policy of the social network or application itself.

You guarantee to provide only true and updated personal data.

Processing for management purposes:

Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” will process your personal data to manage the purchase request you make, which includes, among others, the following specific processing: those necessary to fulfill our obligations arising from the purchase request you make; and the sending, including by electronic means, of non-promotional information necessary for you to access or benefit from said purchase request.

Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” is legitimized for the indicated processing of your personal data as it is necessary for the execution of the contract between our entity and you, and thus fulfill what you request from us.

Processing for communication purposes with regard to similar activities:

”la Caixa” Banking Foundation will also process your Personal Data to send, including by electronic means, communications regarding programmes, activities or similar services requested by you. The Personal Data processed for such purpose are your identification data (forenames and surnames, date of birth and gender) and contact details (postcode, electronic address, language and telephone).

Sending promotional communications to persons such as yourself, with whom we have a prior direct relationship, is based on the entity's legitimate interest in publicising our programmes, activities or similar services in which you participate or have participated and which may be of your interest since they may improve your chances of receiving support for your needs.

We inform you that the regulations on information society and electronic commerce services and on privacy enable us to carry out such promotional communications by electronic means without the need for your prior consent, provided that they promote programmes, activities or services of your interest and which are similar to the purpose of the direct relationship with you, after your acceptance of our privacy policies.

The data protection regulations establish the need to draft internal reports on the balance between the legitimate interest described and your privacy. Those reports confirm that the entity can carry out this processing for the purpose of communicating the programmes, activities or similar services in which you participate or have participated and which may be of your interest, without harming your privacy rights.

You can object to receiving these types of communications at present or at any other time and can receive further information about the balancing reports or about the processing of your personal data based on the legitimate interest by sending a request to the Data Protection Officer at the stated postal or electronic addresses.

Consent for processing for communication purposes regarding activities of our entity:

If you select the option to receive information on other activities of our entity, you EXPRESSLY CONSENT to our entity sending you communications and information, including by electronic means, relating to other activities of ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation in the Social, Cultural, Educational, Scientific or Research areas.

The processing of your Personal Data to send communications on other activities of our entity is based on the latest consent granted by you. If you wish us to no longer send you this type of communications, you can revoke your consent at any time, by sending a request to the attention of the Data Protection Officer, at the postal or electronic addresses indicated. Such revocation will not affect the legality of the processing performed prior to the revocation and may lead ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation not to be able to carry out or comply with your request, service, enquiry or purchase, or to such request being affected by said revocation.

Processing for the adequacy of our interaction and communication based on your profile:

”la Caixa” Banking Foundation adapts its interaction and communication with you based on your profile and interests, using data obtained from its own sources in order to have simpler, more efficient and personalized communication with you, and to specify more precisely our interaction.

”la Caixa” Banking Foundation will process this data based on the legitimate interest in accordance with the provisions of the applicable data protection regulations, as it is carried out from internal sources.

Data protection regulations establish the need to prepare internal reports weighing up the legitimate interest described and your privacy. These reports are at your disposal and confirm that our entity can carry out this processing, without prejudice to your privacy rights.

You can object to receiving this type of communications, now or at any other time, as well as receive more information about the weighting reports or about the processing of your personal data based on a legitimate interest by sending a request to the attention of the Data Protection Officer, to the indicated postal or electronic addresses.

Processing for the purpose of sending surveys:

The ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation will process your Personal Data (identification and contact data) to send satisfaction surveys and the subsequent analysis of the resulting information or your interactions with the ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation derived from your particular activity.

This treatment is based on a legitimate interest of our entity, consisting of optimizing operational efficiency and offering greater quality of care to participants enrolled in the different activities and programs offered by our entity.

Data protection regulations establish the need to prepare internal reports weighing up the legitimate interest described and your privacy. These reports are at your disposal and confirm that our entity can carry out this processing, without prejudice to your privacy rights.

You can object to receiving this type of communications, now or at any other time, as well as receive more information about the weighting reports or about the processing of your personal data based on a legitimate interest by sending a request to the attention of the Delegate of Data Protection, to the indicated postal or electronic addresses.

Processing for regulatory purposes and fraud prevention:

The ”la Caixa” Foundation will also process those Personal Data required to comply with its legal and/or regulatory obligations, such as those established by regulations for the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing regulations or tax regulations, being the ”la Caixa” Foundation entitled to do so.

The “la Caixa” Foundation will also process your Personal Data to prevent fraud based on the entity's legitimate interest in preventing fraudulent situations and the corresponding damage to the entity.

Data storage:

The data storage period may vary depending on specific criteria such as your place of residence and the place where your relationship with the entity is formalised.

In any case, your Personal Data will be stored while you hold a relationship with ”la Caixa” Banking Foundation, provided that you do not revoke your consent or exercise your right of objection, portability and/or erasure. If any of the aforementioned circumstances take place, your Personal Data will be stored during the applicable statutory limitation periods in accordance with the corresponding regulations. In this case, they will be processed solely for the purposes of evidencing compliance with our legal or contractual obligations. Once such limitation periods have ended, your data will be deleted or, alternatively, anonymised.

For further information on the specific storage period for your Personal Data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer by writing to the stated postal or electronic addresses.

Automated individual decisions:

The ”la Caixa” Foundation does not adopt decisions that may significantly affect you based exclusively on the automated processing of your Personal Data. All decision-making processes by our entity related with your requests, services, enquiries or purchases involve human intervention.

Personal Data communication to third parties:

”la Caixa” Banking Foundation will not transfer Personal Data to third parties without first obtaining your consent or unless the intervention of suppliers is required to provide a service to the corresponding party, as well as to Spanish and European Public Administrations and Control Authorities for compliance with the legal obligations to which “la Caixa” Banking Foundation is subject at any given time due to its nature and activity.

International data transfers:

The ”la Caixa” Foundation can carry out international data transfers to entities located in countries outside the European Economic Area, which guarantee a level of protection equivalent to the General Data Protection Regulation.

Additionally, “la Caixa” Foundation may also contract services from technology providers located in countries outside the European Economic Area. In the event of contracting said services, such contracting would comply with all the requirements established by the data protection regulations, applying the necessary guarantees and safeguards to the transfer of your Personal Data to preserve your privacy.

Likewise, exceptionally, your Personal Data may also be transferred to entities located outside the European Economic Area when necessary for important reasons of public interest and/or in accordance with the provisions of Spanish and European regulations to which ”la Caixa” Foundation is subject by reason of its activity.

For more information on the guarantees for your privacy or on the regulations that justify the possible international transfers of your data, you can contact the Data Protection Officer, through the postal and electronic addresses indicated.

Rights:

You can withdraw the consent granted, and exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and/or objection to processing at the postal or electronic addresses indicated.

The document also explains the rights you can exercise regarding the various types of processing of Personal Data that may be related to your request, service, enquiry or purchase.

Data Protection Officer:

For further information on the guarantees to your privacy, please contact our Data Protection Officer at the following address: Avenida Diagonal, numbers 621–629, Tower II, 08028 Barcelona (Spain), or at the email address dpd@fundacionlacaixa.org.

Complaints:

If you consider that the processing of your Personal Data breaches the regulations or this document, you may file a complaint: to our Data Protection Officer at the postal or electronic addresses indicated; or before the Spanish Data Protection Authority, on its website or to its postal address.

A. INFORMACIÓN LEGAL SOBRE LA FUNDACIÓN BANCARIA CAIXA D'ESTALVIS I PENSIONS DE BARCELONA, ”LA CAIXA”

Fundación Bancaria Caixa d'Estalvis i Pensions de Barcelona, ”la Caixa” (en adelante, "Fundación Bancaria ”la Caixa””), con NIF G-58899998 es el resultado de la transformación en fundación bancaria de la Caixa d'Estalvis i Pensions de Barcelona ”la Caixa”.

Consta inscrita en el Registro de Fundaciones del Ministerio de Justicia, con el número 1.658 y en el Registro Mercantil de Palma de Mallorca, tomo 2772, folio 21, hoja PM-84543. Está sujeta al Protectorado de Fundaciones Bancarias del Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa, y tiene el domicilio social en Barcelona, Avenida Diagonal 621-629, código postal 08028.

Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa”, orienta su actividad principal a la atención y desarrollo de la obra social y a la adecuada gestión de su participación en CaixaBank, S.A., de conformidad con aquello que dispone la Ley 26/2013, de 27 de diciembre, de cajas de ahorros y fundaciones bancarias.

B. CONDICIONES GENERALES DE COMPRA DE ENTRADAS Y DE ACCESO A LOS CENTROS Y EXPOSICIONES ITINERANTES DE FUNDACIÓN BANCARIA “LA CAIXA”

1. Objeto y ámbito de aplicación

El objeto del presente documento es la regulación de los términos y condiciones de compra de entradas y de acceso de los Centros CaixaForum, Museo de la Ciencia CosmoCaixa Barcelona, centro Palau Macaya Barcelona, Jardines de Cap Roig y Exposiciones y Talleres itinerantes de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” (en adelante, los “Centros”).

Las condiciones del presente documento se aplicarán a todas las personas que compren una entrada, y/o accedan a los Centros con la finalidad de visitar la colección permanente, las exposiciones temporales y/o sus instalaciones (tanto interiores como exteriores), y/o de participar en actividades organizadas por Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa”, en cualquiera de los espacios de estos.

En adelante, la colección permanente, las exposiciones temporales y las actividades citadas anteriormente serán referidas conjuntamente como la/s “Actividad/es”.

La compra de entradas para las Actividades se entiende realizada en el domicilio social de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” (ello sin perjuicio de la sumisión a los Jueces y Tribunales que corresponda) y supone la aceptación de las presentes condiciones generales en el momento de su formalización.

2. Condiciones generales de la compra de entradas

La reserva de entradas para grupos se podrá realizar telefónicamente y/o por correo electrónico, de acuerdo con la información disponible en las páginas web de los Centros o través del portal educativo de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” (en adelante, “la/s Página/s Web”).

La compra de las entradas se podrá realizar en los puntos de venta habilitados y en la recepción de los Centros, y así como de forma on-line a través de las Páginas Web (en adelante, los “Puntos Oficiales de Venta”), con selección de pase horario (fecha y hora) y de las localidades, en su caso.

En lo no previsto en las presentes condiciones generales, será de aplicación lo establecido en la normativa vigente.

El usuario debe cumplimentar correctamente los datos que se le requieren en el proceso de reserva y/o compra y se compromete a no comunicar e introducir datos de terceros o inciertos.

En caso de reserva de entradas para grupos, una vez realizada la reserva, el usuario recibirá un correo electrónico de confirmación. Una vez se haya realizado el correspondiente pago, recibirá asimismo un correo electrónico de confirmación de la compra realizada, junto con las entradas adquiridas. En caso de reservas gratuitas, las entradas se recibirán una vez confirmada su asistencia. En caso de reserva de actividades en Exposiciones y Talleres Itinerantes, las entradas se recibirán en el momento de la confirmación de la reserva realizada.

En caso de compra online, el usuario recibirá igualmente un correo electrónico de confirmación de la compra realizada, junto con las entradas, en un plazo máximo de 24 horas.

Desde el momento del pago, quedará perfeccionada la compraventa y obligadas ambas partes al cumplimiento de lo acordado.

La compra de la/s entrada/s representa el conocimiento previo y la aceptación de las siguientes condiciones:

  1. Los precios de las entradas estarán expresados en euros e incluirán el IVA en vigor en la fecha de la compra. Los precios que aparecen en el momento de la compra son los que se aplicarán a la misma. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” es libre de modificar el precio de las entradas en cualquier momento, sin que ello afecte a las entradas ya adquiridas. Igualmente, Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” podrá ofrecer entradas gratuitas para las Actividades.
  2. La compra de entradas online permite (i) imprimir la entrada en el mismo momento de finalización del proceso de compra, y/o (ii) guardar el archivo en el ordenador o dispositivo móvil para la posterior impresión y/o uso en el control de acceso a los Centros. En situaciones excepcionales, cuando por motivos técnicos y/o de seguridad las dos opciones anteriores estén desactivadas, el comprador podrá recoger la/s entrada/s en las recepciones de los Centros, presentando el resguardo de la operación de compra (confirmación de compra) enviado por correo electrónico. En el caso de compra presencial en la recepción de los Centros o en los puntos habilitados en las Exposiciones y Talleres itinerantes, el comprador podrá elegir (i) imprimir la entrada adquirida, y/o (ii) el envío de la entrada al correo electrónico que desee, para la posterior impresión y/o uso en el control de acceso.
  3. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” podrá grabar y/o realizar fotografías durante la Actividad. Las imágenes y/o fotografías podrán ser publicadas en sus páginas web y/o en sus redes sociales, previas las autorizaciones correspondientes de los asistentes, con la finalidad de difusión informativa o promocional de la Actividad.
  4. No está permitida la captación, filmación o grabación de imágenes o sonidos de la Actividad, sin la previa autorización de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa”.
  5. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva todos los derechos derivados de la Actividad, cuando así le corresponda.
  6. Se podrán realizar cambios o anulaciones de las entradas adquiridas hasta 20 días naturales antes de la fecha de la Actividad, con la devolución del importe total abonado.
  7. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva el derecho, por motivos técnicos, artísticos o de fuerza mayor que imposibiliten la celebración de la Actividad en las mismas condiciones anunciadas, a modificar las fechas, los horarios o los intérpretes anunciados (modificación sustancial de la Actividad), y también a decretar la suspensión o cancelación de la Actividad por los mismos motivos. En todos estos casos de modificación sustancial, suspensión o cancelación de la Actividad, Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” procederá a la devolución del importe total abonado.
  8. La adquisición de entradas o de pases de acceso no otorga a su portador el derecho a utilizarlos, o su contenido, con finalidades publicitarias, de marketing o de promoción (incluidos los concursos, regalos y/o sorteos), si no es con el previo consentimiento expreso y escrito de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa”.

3. Condiciones generales de acceso

El acceso a los Centros (tanto a sus instalaciones interiores como exteriores) así como a las Actividades queda sujeto a las siguientes condiciones:

  1. Se requiere estar en posesión de una entrada o pase de acceso que permita superar el control de acceso a los Centros, salvo aquellos espacios interiores y/o exteriores que no precisen de una entrada o pase de acceso.
  2. La entrada o pase de acceso podrá ser requerido por el personal autorizado en cualquier momento y debe conservarse hasta el final de la Actividad.
  3. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” no garantiza la autenticidad de la entrada o pase de acceso si la entrada no ha sido adquirida en alguno de los Puntos Oficiales de Venta o si el pase no ha sido entregado o recibido por el personal o canal autorizado.
  4. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva el derecho de admisión. Este derecho se ejercerá con respeto a la dignidad de las personas y a sus derechos fundamentales, y en ningún caso se utilizará para restringir el acceso de manera arbitraria o discriminatoria, ni situar al usuario en condiciones de inferioridad, indefensión o agravio comparativo.
  5. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” impedirá el acceso y permanencia de las personas en los Centros y/o en las Actividades en las siguientes situaciones:
    1. Cuando el aforo establecido se halle completo.
    2. Cuando se haya superado el horario del cierre del Centro y/o de la Actividad.
    3. Cuando la persona que pretende acceder a los Centros y/o Actividad, o se encuentre en su interior, se encuentre en alguna de las circunstancias o manifieste alguno de los comportamientos siguientes:
      1. Manifestar actitudes violentas, o que puedan producir molestias al público o personal del Centro, o puedan alterar el normal desarrollo del Centro o de la Actividad.
      2. Portar armas u objetos susceptibles de ser utilizados como tales, salvo que, de conformidad con lo dispuesto en cada momento por la normativa específica aplicable, se trate de miembros de las Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad o de escoltas privados integrados en empresas de seguridad privada inscritas para el ejercicio de dicha actividad y accedan a los Centros en el ejercicio de sus funciones.
      3. Llevar símbolos, prendas u objetos que inciten a la violencia, el racismo o la xenofobia.
      4. Consumir drogas, sustancias estupefacientes o psicotrópicas, o mostrar síntomas de haberlas consumido, así como dar signos evidentes de embriaguez.
  6. Para acceder a los Centros, los menores de 16 años deberán ir acompañados de su representante legal o un adulto responsable. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva el derecho de solicitar documento acreditativo de la edad del asistente a la entrada del Centro o, posteriormente, dentro del mismo.
  7. No se permite la entrada a los Centros de:
    • Todo tipo de animales, excepto perros guía, de asistencia o auxiliares terapéuticos, con la acreditación correspondiente. Se permite la entrada de perros con correa en el Centro Jardines de Cap Roig (Girona), dadas las particularidades de dicho centro.
    • Patinetes, monopatines, patines o bicicletas (incluidos eléctricos). No obstante, se permite su depósito en las consignas (a excepción de los eléctricos), siempre que las dimensiones de las que se encuentren disponibles lo permitan. Respecto de las bicicletas, podrán entrar hasta los puntos de aparcamiento que a tal efecto se hayan habilitado en los Centros.
  8. Se permite acceder a los Centros y a las Actividades con bolsos y mochilas de pequeño tamaño (inferiores a 40x30x10 cm). Por razones de seguridad, aquellas mochilas, bolsas o maletas que superen dichas dimensiones deberán depositarse en las consignas de los Centros.
  9. Los Centros (a excepción de las Exposiciones y Talleres itinerantes) disponen de un servicio gratuito de consignas para guardar prendas y objetos personales, sujeto a disponibilidad. Todas las prendas y objetos depositados en consiga deberán ser retirados antes del cierre de los Centros.

4. Videovigilancia

En el caso de que existan cámaras de videovigilancia en el Centro, se informará a los usuarios en el acceso al mismo y de conformidad con la normativa de protección de datos, entre otros, de que las imágenes captadas a través de dichos sistemas pasarán a formar parte de un fichero responsabilidad de Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” con la finalidad de control de accesos y seguridad del Centro y de la Actividad, así como de resolución de cualquier incidencia. El usuario puede ejercer los derechos de acceso, supresión y limitación de sus datos y al tratamiento de estos ante Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” en la dirección de correo electrónico dpd@fundacionlacaixa.org o en la dirección postal Avenida Diagonal 621 – 629, 08028 Barcelona.

5. Responsabilidad

Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” no se hace responsable de los daños y perjuicios de cualquier naturaleza derivados de hechos en los que no intervenga culpa o negligencia por su parte.

6. Consultas y reclamaciones

Para cualquier consulta sobre las presentes condiciones generales, así como para realizar cualquier comunicación de incidencia o reclamación, el usuario puede ponerse en contacto a través del siguiente teléfono y/o dirección de correo electrónico:

900 22 30 40

info@contact.fundaciolacaixa.org

De conformidad con el art. 14.1 del Reglamento (UE) 524/2013, el usuario también puede solicitar una resolución extrajudicial de controversias en materia de consumo a través de la plataforma de resolución de litigios en línea de la Comisión Europea, a la que se puede acceder a través del siguiente enlace http://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/

Asimismo, el usuario puede ponerse en contacto con nuestra entidad a través de nuestra web https://www.fundacionbancarialacaixa.org/ en la opción Atención al usuario que se encuentra en la parte inferior de la web.

C. AVISO LEGAL, POLÍTICA DE PRIVACIDAD Y POLÍTICA DE COOKIES

1. Validez de la información y contenidos

La información contenida en esta web es la vigente en la fecha de su última actualización.

Las presentes condiciones son las vigentes desde la fecha de su última actualización. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva el derecho a modificarlas en cualquier momento, en cuyo caso entrarán en vigor desde su publicación y serán aplicables a todos los usuarios de la Página Web desde esa fecha.

Los contenidos de la Página Web, en especial las referencias informativas y publicitarias, en su caso, salvo que expresamente se indique lo contrario, no constituyen ningún tipo de oferta vinculante. Fundación Bancaria ”la Caixa” se reserva el derecho a introducir modificaciones u omitir parcial o totalmente los actuales contenidos cuando lo considere oportuno, así como impedir o restringir el acceso de forma temporal o permanente.

Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” podrá incluir en cualquiera de sus Páginas Web contenidos de terceros y enlaces a páginas web de terceros, siempre con la autorización de sus titulares, tales como a redes sociales y a otras informaciones. En ninguno de esos casos Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” será responsable de las páginas y contenidos de terceros, así como del funcionamiento y disponibilidad de los mismos.

La Página Web puede permitir a los usuarios introducir contenidos. Fundación Bancaria “la Caixa” se reserva el derecho a no publicar, retirar o eliminar todos los contenidos que considere incorrectos inexactos o contrarios al presente Aviso legal y Política de Privacidad.

Los usuarios no podrán incluir en la Página Web contenidos referidos a confesiones religiosas o ideas políticas (incluidas declaraciones y símbolos de partidos políticos y organizaciones religiosas), ni antisociales, ni ofensivos a valores culturales o religiosos, provocativos, despectivos, violentos, obscenos, sexuales y/o de grupos que no son socialmente aceptables o ilegales, así como cualquier otro que pueda herir la sensibilidad de terceras personas, vulnerar los derechos fundamentales y las libertades públicas reconocidas por la normativa aplicable y/o los establecidos en la legislación sobre derechos de los consumidores y usuarios, sobre la protección de la infancia y la juventud, constituir o suponer una intromisión en la intimidad personal o familiar de las personas físicas o violación del derecho al honor de terceros o del secreto de las comunicaciones. En cualquier caso el usuario será el único responsable de las opiniones emitidas así como de la veracidad, exactitud y/o licitud de los mismos.

La inclusión de contenidos sujetos a derechos de autor y a derechos de imagen queda condicionada a que el usuario ostente legitimación suficiente y obtenga las autorizaciones necesarias para que el contenido pueda ser utilizado, tanto por él mismo como por el resto de usuarios, en los términos previstos en el presente Aviso Legal y Política de Privacidad, y que su utilización no suponga vulneración de ninguna previsión legal, contrato, derecho o propiedad de terceros, ni de ningún modo suponga competencia desleal.

En consecuencia, por el hecho de incluir contenidos en la Página Web se entenderá que el usuario que lo incluye cuenta con la referida legitimación.

2. Política de privacidad y protección de datos

Fundación Bancaria ”la Caixa” cumple íntegramente con la legislación vigente en materia de protección de datos de carácter personal y con los compromisos de confidencialidad propios de su actividad.

Fundación Bancaria ”la Caixa” ha adoptado las medidas técnicas necesarias para mantener el nivel de seguridad requerido, según la naturaleza de los datos personales tratados y las circunstancias del tratamiento, con el objeto de evitar, en la medida de lo posible y siempre según el estado de la técnica, su alteración, pérdida, tratamiento o acceso no autorizado.

Cuando sea solicitada la cumplimentación de un formulario en el que se recojan datos de carácter personal, se informará al usuario de la identidad y los datos del responsable del tratamiento de datos y del delegado de protección de datos, de los fines y de la base jurídica del tratamiento, de los destinatarios de los datos, en su caso, de las transferencias internacionales de datos, en su caso, de los plazos de conservación de los datos y de la facultad del usuario de ejercitar sus derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, portabilidad, limitación y/u oposición al tratamiento, del derecho a presentar una reclamación ante la autoridad de control y de la existencia de decisiones automatizadas, en su caso. Los datos personales recogidos solo serán tratados y/o cedidos con la expresada finalidad, y siempre con el consentimiento del usuario.

allocation.description: Arrange assets by position. The distance between them sets the allocation priority — closer assets are grouped first.

example.ariaLabel: See an example of how asset allocation works
example.case1: A booking for 2 lanes is allocated to lanes 7 and 8 — the two available lanes with the shortest distance between them.
example.case2: A booking for 1 lane is allocated to lane 3 — the available lane closest to the occupied ones, keeping larger blocks free for bigger bookings.
example.case3: A booking for 3 lanes is allocated to lanes 6, 7 and 8 — the three available lanes with the shortest distance between them.
example.case4: A booking for 4 lanes is allocated to lanes 7, 8, 9 and 10 — the four available lanes with the shortest distance between them.
example.intro: In this example a hub has 10 bowling lanes placed on the axis. Amber lanes are already occupied by other bookings, and the greyed spots are gaps — empty positions that count towards the distance.

steps.broadcastOn: Turn on "Broadcast output". Leave the action and keys as they are (com.imin.scanner.api.RESULT_ACTION, decode_data_str).

bookedSlotMoveRejection.activityNotRunByAsset: This booking's activity is not run by {{assetName}}. Pick an asset that runs it.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.availabilityStrategyMismatch: This booking cannot move to {{assetName}} because the two assets count occupancy in different units (groups and people). Pick an asset that counts occupancy the same way.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.bookedSlotPinned: The asset assignment of {{blockingBooking}} is already confirmed, so it cannot change asset or time. Move the other bookings around it.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.bookedSlotPinnedUnnamed: This move is blocked by a booking whose asset assignment is already confirmed, so that booking cannot change asset or time. Move the other bookings around it.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.bookedSlotWithoutActivity: {{blockingBooking}} is a booking with no activity (such as a venue hire or an exclusive), so it cannot be moved out of the way. Move or cancel it first.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.bookedSlotWithoutActivityPack: This move would relocate a booking whose ticket type is no longer linked to assets, so it cannot be done. Link the ticket type to an activity again to move it.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.bookedSlotWithoutActivityUnnamed: This move is blocked by a booking with no activity (such as a venue hire or an exclusive), which cannot be moved out of the way. Move or cancel it first.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.capacityRuleClosed: The capacity rule "{{ruleName}}" leaves this asset with no capacity between {{from}} and {{until}}. Move the booking outside that stretch or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.capacityRuleClosedAllDay: The capacity rule "{{ruleName}}" leaves this asset with no capacity all day. Pick another asset for this booking.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.capacityRuleClosedAllDayUnnamed: A capacity rule leaves this asset with no capacity all day. Pick another asset for this booking.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.capacityRuleClosedUnnamed: A capacity rule leaves this asset with no capacity between {{from}} and {{until}}. Move the booking outside that stretch or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.crossDay: The booking would run past the end of the day. Start it earlier or shorten it so it finishes on the same day.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.dayException: A day exception ("{{ruleName}}") closes this asset between {{from}} and {{until}}. Move the booking outside that stretch or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.dayExceptionAllDay: A day exception ("{{ruleName}}") closes this asset all day. Pick another asset for this booking.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.dayExceptionAllDayUnnamed: A day exception closes this asset all day. Pick another asset for this booking.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.dayExceptionUnnamed: A day exception closes this asset between {{from}} and {{until}}. Move the booking outside that stretch or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.itemsStayInPlace: Moving this booking only moves its items that use assets. These items stay as they are: {{items}}.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.itemsStayInPlaceBookedSlotsOnly: Moving this booking only moves its items that use assets. Part of it is no longer linked to assets, so it keeps its current place in the calendar.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.itemsStayInPlaceWithBookedSlots: Moving this booking only moves its items that use assets. These items stay as they are, and the ones whose ticket type is no longer linked to assets keep their current place in the calendar: {{items}}.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.movePlanTooComplex: This move sets off a chain of changes that cannot be applied in one go. Try a smaller move.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.noCompatibleAssetAvailable: No free asset running the same activity can take {{blockingBooking}} at its time. Move or cancel that booking first, or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.noCompatibleAssetAvailableUnnamed: No free asset running the same activity can take one of the affected bookings at its time. Move or cancel that booking first, or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.noLaterPositionAvailable: Moving this booking would push {{blockingBooking}} later, and no later position fits it today. Move this booking earlier or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.noLaterPositionAvailableUnnamed: Moving this booking would push another booking later, and no later position fits it today. Move this booking earlier or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.outsideOpeningWindow: This asset is closed between {{from}} and {{until}}. Move the booking inside its opening hours or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.outsideOpeningWindowAllDay: This asset is closed all day. Pick another asset for this booking.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.packCannotBePushed: {{blockingBooking}} was sold as part of a pack, so it cannot be moved to a later time on its own. Move the whole pack instead.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.packCannotBePushedUnnamed: One of the affected bookings was sold as part of a pack, so it cannot be moved to a later time on its own. Move the whole pack instead.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.partyDoesNotFitAsset: The group does not fit {{assetName}}. Check its minimum and maximum party size and its maximum number of groups, or pick another asset.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.relatedBookingChangesDay: This move would carry {{blockingBooking}}, which is part of a pack, out of its day. Move that booking on its own first, or make a smaller move.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.relatedBookingChangesDayUnnamed: This move would carry a booking that is part of a pack out of its day. Move that booking on its own first, or make a smaller move.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.relocationLost: The spot this booking was going to was just taken. Please try again.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.repeatedActivityMustUseADifferentAsset: This booking belongs to a pack that runs its activity on a different asset each time, and {{blockingBooking}} already runs it on {{assetName}}.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.repeatedActivityMustUseADifferentAssetUn: This booking belongs to a pack that runs its activity on a different asset each time, and another booking of the same pack already runs it on {{assetName}}.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.repeatedActivityMustUseTheSameAsset: This booking belongs to a pack that runs every repetition of its activity on one asset, and {{blockingBooking}} does not run it on {{assetName}}.
bookedSlotMoveRejection.repeatedActivityMustUseTheSameAssetUnnam: This booking belongs to a pack that runs every repetition of its activity on one asset, and the rest of the pack does not run it on {{assetName}}.

hint.addOnDiscount: Amount discounted on add-on prices with promo codes and promotions, excluding the surcharge. Formula: Add-ons Discount
hint.addOnRevenue: Revenue from add-ons (parking, food, merchandise…), excluding surcharges. Formula: Add-ons Revenue
hint.addOnsInvitations: Complimentary add-ons issued at no charge. Formula: Add-ons Invitation
hint.addOnsIssued: Every add-on issued in the period, sold or invited. Formula: Add-ons Sold + Add-ons Invitation
hint.addOnsSold: Number of add-ons sold in the period, excluding invitations. Formula: Add-ons Sold
hint.addOnSurcharge: Booking fees charged to buyers on top of the add-on price. Formula: Add-ons Surcharge
hint.addOnSurchargeDiscount: Amount discounted on the booking fees of add-ons. Formula: Add-ons Surcharge Discount
hint.addOnUserPayment: What buyers paid for add-ons after discounts. Formula: Add-ons Gross Revenue + Add-ons Discount + Add-ons Surcharge Discount
hint.discount: Amount discounted with promo codes and promotions, on prices and booking fees. Formula: Face Value Discount + Surcharge Discount
hint.faceValue: What tickets, add-ons, products and subscriptions were first sold for, excluding surcharges and resales. Formula: Tickets Revenue + Add-ons Revenue + Product Revenue + Subscription Revenue
hint.faceValueDiscount: Amount discounted on the prices of tickets, add-ons and products, excluding surcharges. Formula: Tickets Discount + Add-ons Discount + Product Discount
hint.grossRevenue: Everything buyers were charged before discounts: face value, surcharges and resales. Formula: Face Value + Surcharge + Secondary Market
hint.guestlistOnlyOrders: Orders holding nothing but guestlist registrations, at no charge. Formula: Guestlist-only Orders
hint.invitationOnlyOrders: Orders holding nothing but invitations, at no charge. Formula: Invitation-only Orders
hint.itemDiscount: Amount discounted on ticket prices with promo codes and promotions, excluding the surcharge. Formula: Tickets Discount
hint.itemRevenue: Revenue from ticket prices, excluding surcharges and add-ons. Formula: Tickets Revenue
hint.itemsGuestlist: Tickets taken through a guestlist, at no charge and apart from invitations. Formula: Tickets Guestlist
hint.itemsInvitations: Complimentary tickets issued at no charge. Formula: Tickets Invitation
hint.itemsIssued: Every ticket issued in the period: sold, invited or taken through a guestlist. Formula: Tickets Sold + Tickets Invitation + Tickets Guestlist
hint.itemsSold: Number of tickets first sold in the period, excluding invitations and guestlist. Resales are left out: the Resales tab shows them. Formula: Tickets Sold
hint.itemSurcharge: Booking fees charged to buyers on top of the ticket price. Formula: Tickets Surcharge
hint.itemSurchargeDiscount: Amount discounted on the booking fees of tickets. Formula: Tickets Surcharge Discount
hint.itemUserPayment: What buyers paid for tickets after discounts. Formula: Tickets Gross Revenue + Tickets Discount + Tickets Surcharge Discount
hint.orders: Every order placed in the period: sold, invitation-only or guestlist-only. Formula: Orders Sold + Invitation-only Orders + Guestlist-only Orders
hint.ordersSold: Orders with at least one paid item, including those that also hold invitations. Formula: Orders Sold
hint.ordersWithInvitations: Orders holding at least one invitation, with or without paid items. Those with a paid item are already in Orders sold, so this figure overlaps the others and is not part of the total. Formula: Orders with Invitations
hint.productDiscount: Amount discounted on product prices with promo codes and promotions, excluding the surcharge. Formula: Product Discount
hint.productRevenue: Revenue from products (merchandise, experiences, upgrades, parking…), excluding surcharges. Formula: Product Revenue
hint.productSurcharge: Booking fees charged to buyers on top of the product price. Formula: Product Surcharge
hint.productSurchargeDiscount: Amount discounted on the booking fees of products. Formula: Product Surcharge Discount
hint.productUserPayment: What buyers paid for products after discounts. Formula: Product Gross Revenue + Product Discount + Product Surcharge Discount
hint.resaleCommission: Your commission on the price of each ticket resold. Formula: Resale Fee
hint.resaleSurcharge: The surcharges charged to buyers on resales. Formula: Resale Surcharge
hint.secondaryMarket: Your revenue on tickets resold on the secondary market. Formula: Resale Fee + Resale Surcharge
hint.secondaryMarketUserPayment: What resale buyers paid you on the secondary market: the resale fee and surcharge, with no discount on them. Formula: Resale Fee + Resale Surcharge
hint.subscriptionRevenue: Revenue from subscription fees paid in the period. Formula: Subscription Revenue
hint.subscriptionUserPayment: What buyers paid in subscription fees. Formula: Subscription Revenue
hint.surcharge: Booking fees charged to buyers on top of the price. Formula: Tickets Surcharge + Add-ons Surcharge + Product Surcharge
hint.surchargeDiscount: Amount discounted on the booking fees charged to buyers. Onebox discounts are all on the price. Formula: Tickets Surcharge Discount + Add-ons Surcharge Discount + Product Surcharge Discount
hint.userPayment: What buyers actually paid after discounts. Formula: Gross Revenue + Discount

hintGuestlist.grossPerItem: Average spend per ticket, before discounts, guestlist counted: what the tickets and their add-ons brought in, surcharges included. hintInvitations.grossPerItem: Average spend per ticket, before discounts, invitations counted: what the tickets and their add-ons brought in, surcharges included. hintInvitationsNet.grossPerItem: Average spend per ticket after discounts, invitations counted: what buyers paid for the tickets and their add-ons, surcharges included. hintInvitationsNet.grossPerOrder: Average amount buyers paid per order, after discounts, resales included, subscription fees left out, invitation-only orders counted. Formula: (User Payment - Subscription Revenue) / (Orders Sold + Invitation-only Orders)

hintNet.averageItemPrice: Average price per ticket after discounts, surcharge included, invitations and guestlist counted. Resales are left out. Formula: Tickets User Payment / Tickets

hintNet.grossPerItem: Average spend per ticket after discounts, invitations and guestlist counted: what buyers paid for the tickets and their add-ons, surcharges included. Resales, products and subscription fees are left out. Formula: (Tickets User Payment + Add-ons User Payment) / Tickets
hintNet.grossPerOrder: Average amount buyers paid per order, after discounts, resales included, subscription fees left out, invitation-only and guestlist-only orders counted. Formula: (User Payment - Subscription Revenue) / Orders

hintPaid.averageItemPrice: Average price per ticket sold, surcharge included, before discounts. Resales are left out. Formula: (Tickets Revenue + Tickets Surcharge) / Tickets Sold
hintPaid.averageProductPrice: Average price per product sold, surcharge included, before discounts. Formula: (Product Revenue + Product Surcharge) / Products Sold
